description: This file defines interfaces and includes necessary headers for the TR-104 support functionality within the MTA agent component. It declares functions for getting, setting, and freeing TR-104 parameter values and retrieving parameter names.

methods.name: mta_hal_getTR104parameterValues
methods.description: Function to retrieve TR-104 parameter values for specified parameters.

methods.name: mta_hal_freeTR104parameterValues
methods.description: Function to free the memory allocated for TR-104 parameter values.

methods.name: mta_hal_setTR104parameterValues
methods.description: Function to set TR-104 parameter values.

methods.name: mta_hal_getTR104parameterNames
methods.description: Function to retrieve the list of TR-104 parameter names.

methods.name: TR104_open
methods.description: Function to initialize or open the TR-104 related interface or connection.
